versions.changelog: 修复安全审查问题：1) SKILL.md 添加副作用说明（磁盘写入、文件修改、持久化记录）；2) 脚本中 eval 替换为数组命令执行，消除 shell 注入风险
修复安全审查问题：1) SKILL.md 添加副作用说明（磁盘写入、文件修改、持久化记录）；2) 脚本中 eval 替换为数组命令执行，消除 shell 注入风险
修复脚本中多处 bash/Python 交互问题：Avatar更新改用heredoc+sys.argv避免转义陷阱；正则同时匹配粗体/无粗体两种格式并增加兜底追加；命令执行改为bash数组正确处理空格路径；验证和MAIN_WORKSPACE的python3调用统一改为heredoc传参；MISSING数组加引号兼容set -u
Fix: dynamically resolve main workspace path via openclaw CLI instead of hardcoded /root/.openclaw/openclaw.json; three-level fallback (agents list -> config file -> ~/.openclaw/workspace)
修复 history.md 更新覆盖问题（新增 .clawignore 排除本地记录文件）；头像选择改为 AI 自动匹配，移除用户互动步骤；优化脚本初始化逻辑
Fixed avatar preview path: generate PNG previews inside skills avatars/ dir instead of /tmp/ to stay within allowed MEDIA folders.
Avatar selection now shows numbered preview images (SVG→PNG via rsvg-convert) instead of filenames only.
Added avatar selection: 35 SVG avatars with smart recommendation, numbered selection, auto-default, and IDENTITY.md auto-update.
Cleaned up history.md — removed test agent records from initial release.
Initial release: OpenClaw agent creation skill with guided Q&A, workspace init, and history tracking.
